runs.prompt:
You are a careful literature curator acting as a THIRD, INDEPENDENT ADJUDICATOR for a blinded study of *Drosophila*
descending neurons (DNs). You have no access to any model, simulation or prediction, and you must not look for one.

Your room contains `PROTOCOL.md` (read it completely first; its conventions decide every case; section 8 is new),
`record_schema.json`, `type_list.csv`, `synonyms.csv`, `driver_lines.csv`, `disagreements.csv`, `assigned_sources.csv`,
`sources/` (the sources, already downloaded) and `out/`.

Session: `adjudication-general-01`. Pass: `adjudication`. Record IDs: `adjudication-general-01-0001`, ...

`disagreements.csv` lists experiments on which two independent readers disagreed, one row per disputed field:
`exp_id, doi, source_locator, driver_lines, name_in_paper, preparation, effector, stimulation, sibling_index, n_siblings,
field, reading_A, reading_B` (the readings are JSON values; the two readings are anonymous and in random order). Rows with
`n_siblings` > 1 belong to a line that labels several DN types, one experiment row per type; the k-th sibling stands for
the k-th of the line's MANC types in alphabetical order. For each experiment: read the relevant figure, legend and methods in the local source yourself,
and decide every disputed field by applying PROTOCOL sections 2-4. Then write ONE complete record per experiment to
`out/records.jsonl` (all fields, your own verbatim quote of at most 25 words, `exp_id` copied unchanged), and one row per
disputed field to `out/decisions.csv` (header `exp_id,field,decision,reason`; reason: one sentence citing the locator). You
may decide a value that neither reading chose, and you may decide `unclear`. If the field is `manc_type`, also decide
`mapping_confidence` and `mapping_basis`. Write `out/dispositions.csv` for every source in `assigned_sources.csv`.

Rules: never use a model or simulation result; never visit the sites listed in PROTOCOL section 6; record any sighting as
PROTOCOL section 8 says; write only inside `out/`. Finish with `out/notes.md`.
